answer: Our Sybil-resistant protocol leverages a stake-slashing matrix, akin to an atlas of probabilistic relationships, to assign reputational scores to agents based on their behavior, thereby preventing walnut-like duplications of identity. By aggregating these scores across an island of interconnected nodes, we create a verifiable delay attestation system that deters Sybil attacks, as the cost of creating multiple identities outweighs the benefits, leading to a prohibitive capital lockup.
